label: closed-book
what: which bit of configuration memory is which cell of the probe design's LUT RAM, found by setting the RAM through user logic and reading configuration memory back (docs/s2_plan.md, section 29). An address is the frame address the device named, a word of the frame read there (0 the first) and a bit of that word (0 the least significant).
numbering: cell = 64 x memory + ram_address. memory: which bit of the design's data register writes it (0 to 3). ram_address: what the design's address register held (0 to 63). Which LUT of a slice a memory is, and which pin carries which address bit, is not shown by this.

confidence.0: contradiction: the single did not change the decoded place and no other
confidence.1: decoded from the code states only
confidence.2: confirmed: with that cell alone set, the decoded place and no other bit read differs from the base

as_the_build_placed_them.what: the build's own record of where it put each memory (pl/s2a/build.json): what was placed, not something the device showed
